Plugin.Name: Fabric Routing (FRR)
Plugin.Overview: Optional FRRouting packages for Unraid (zebra, fabricd/OpenFabric, optional OSPF/BGP). Catalog + flash cache on Apply; array start rehydrates packages already on flash. Settings → Network Settings → Fabric Routing. Standalone — Thunderbolt Net not required. Does not edit eth0/br0 by default. Pair with Thunderbolt Net for OpenFabric policy on the Thunderbolt underlay.
